camel_example: aliyun iot ReplaceEdgeInstanceGateway --region cn-hangzhou --CurrentGatewayId oTCJomvT95WPyPPQ5sje000000 --InstanceId G4TGWGYwpo8zwr000000 --NewGatewayId 65SkFyhZcU5d3PO2Ri13000000
description_en: Replaces the gateway that is bound to an edge instance. After the gateway is replaced, the deployment status and deployment history of the original gateway are cleared
description_zh: 替换已绑定到边缘实例的网关。替换网关后，原网关的部署状态和部署历史会被清除
kebab_example: aliyun iot replace-edge-instance-gateway --instance-id G4TGWGYwpo8zwr000000 --current-gateway-id oTCJomvT95WPyPPQ5sje000000 --new-gateway-id 65SkFyhZcU5d3PO2Ri13000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ReplaceEdgeInstanceGateway

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the edge instance. On the Edge Instances page of the Edge Computing console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the name of the target edge instance to obtain the ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh:
边缘实例的ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的边缘实例页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The IotId of the current gateway device. IotId is the unique identifier generated by IoT Platform for the device. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69905.html operation to query the IotId
parameters.help_zh: 当前网关设备的IotId。IotId是物联网平台为设备生成的唯一标识符。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69905.html接口查询
parameters.name: current_gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The IotId of the new gateway device that you want to use as a replacement. IotId is the unique identifier generated by IoT Platform for the device. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69905.html operation to query the IotId
parameters.help_zh: 要替换的新网关设备的IotId。IotId是物联网平台为设备生成的唯一标识符。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69905.html接口查询
parameters.name: new_gateway_id

Code.description_zh: 接口返回码。Success表示成功，其它表示错误码。详情请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）

ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
